_comment: Which fork commit pairs with this repo's state. Same pattern as wowsims.lock.json (plan decision D1). branchedFrom is the v0.0.101 pin from wowsims.lock.json, not upstream master: decision D2 keeps the fork on the pin so every verified fact and committed datum traces to one commit. The clone at clonePath is gitignored (vendor/) and has its own .git pushing to the personal fork. pushed:false records that nothing has left this machine -- plan section 1 keeps any push behind a separate explicit ask, so flipping this flag is a deliberate act, not a side effect.
